title: Kota Kinabalu Half Marathon 2026 Review: Sabah's Capital-City 21K
seo_title: Kota Kinabalu Half Marathon 2026 Review | Sabah Malaysia Race
meta_description: Kota Kinabalu Half Marathon 2026: August 16 at Karamunsing, KK. A 21.1K in Sabah's capital with Mount Kinabalu on the horizon.
dek: Set for 16 August 2026 at Karamunsing in Kota Kinabalu — Sabah's coastal capital — this half marathon offers a 21.1K with Mount Kinabalu views.
verdict: The Kota Kinabalu Half Marathon brings a road race to Sabah's capital — a coastal city with the UNESCO-listed Mount Kinabalu on the horizon and some of the best seafood in Malaysia. Anchored at Karamunsing, a central KK commercial district. August in Sabah is the southwest monsoon — warm but the coastal breezes help. A solid Sabah half marathon for runners wanting a Borneo race with city convenience and mountain views.
